_comment: Initial experience memory (Sec. 3.2.2). Copied to runtime/experience_memory.json on first run; reflection insights are appended there. Operators may also add entries manually.

entries.key: Reduction of available lanes from three to two for a seven-CAV formation with a 2–3–2 lane-wise distribution.
entries.value: Allocate four target positions to Lane 2 and three to Lane 1 rather than the reverse, as this reduces the required number of lane changes from four to three.
